entries.not_relevant_because: The only sphere result in the family is the 'Spherical logarithmic energy' corollary of 'Triangular minimality for planar Coulomb renormalized energy', which concerns the logarithmic interaction −Σ log‖yᵢ−yⱼ‖ on the unit sphere S² and gives only the asymptotic linear term of the minimal value as n→∞ (settling the d=2 case of the Brauchart–Hardin–Saff conjecture). It does not treat the 1/r Coulomb interaction that the Thomson problem asks about, and it identifies neither the minimizing configuration nor the minimal energy for any particular n.

The family's packing result, 'A sharp Fourier certificate for planar circle packing', concerns only dimension 2, which the list excludes as already solved; the other three manuscripts are also planar (universal optimality of the triangular lattice in R²), so none determines the densest packing in any dimension other than 1, 2, 3, 8 and 24 or its high-dimensional asymptotics.
